description: Baseline monitoring universe for recurring conference series relevant to computational neuroscience, human neuroimaging and functional connectivity, cognitive neuroscience, EEG/MEG, BCI and neural engineering, neurotechnology, neuroinformatics, and closely related methods communities.
publication_policy: Tracking scope membership does not automatically create a published conference card.
Add an edition to data/conferences.json only when an official source confirms the edition and usable event metadata.
If deadlines are not yet announced, a published edition may use an empty deadlines list plus a tba_note.
Do not infer missing dates, times, time zones, or deadlines.
When official sources materially conflict, keep the series under tracking and defer publication of the disputed field until resolved.

series.name: COSYNE
series.rationale: Premier recurring meeting directly centered on computational and systems neuroscience.

series.name: CNS* / OCNS Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Dedicated computational neuroscience society meeting spanning mathematical, simulation, and experimental work.

series.name: Cognitive Computational Neuroscience (CCN)
series.rationale: Direct intersection of computational modeling, cognitive science, neuroscience, and brain-behavior measurement.

series.name: OHBM Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Primary human neuroimaging and brain-mapping community, highly relevant to fMRI and functional-connectivity research.

series.name: Cognitive Neuroscience Society Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Major human cognitive neuroscience meeting spanning neuroimaging, EEG/MEG, computation, and behavior.

series.name: International BCI Meeting
series.rationale: Specialist global meeting dedicated to brain-computer interface research, development, and translation.

series.name: IEEE EMBS Neural Engineering (NER)
series.rationale: Core neural-engineering venue for neural interfaces, neurotechnology, biosignals, and BCI.

series.name: Society for Psychophysiological Research Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Strong methodological home for EEG/ERP and psychophysiological measurement of cognition and behavior.

series.name: ISMRM & ISMRT Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Key MR methods community relevant to fMRI acquisition, image analysis, and human neuroimaging methodology.

series.name: Society for Neuroscience Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Broad flagship neuroscience meeting with substantial systems, cognitive, imaging, methods, and career-networking value.

series.name: IEEE EMBC
series.rationale: Broad biomedical engineering meeting with strong neural engineering, biomedical signal processing, BCI, and imaging tracks.

series.name: NICE Conference
series.rationale: Neuro-inspired and neuromorphic computing venue with explicit NeuroAI, biosignal-processing, and BCI coverage.

series.name: MICCAI
series.rationale: Leading medical-image-computing community; adjacent through neuroimaging analysis, machine learning, segmentation, and imaging methods.

series.name: INCF Neuroinformatics Assembly
series.rationale: Relevant for neuroinformatics, FAIR neuroscience, reproducibility, standards, data infrastructure, and research software.

series.name: FENS Forum
series.rationale: Major European neuroscience forum with broad scientific coverage and high networking value for European graduate research.

series.name: BIOMAG
series.rationale: Specialist biomagnetism meeting directly relevant to MEG, magnetic sensing, and related analysis methods.
series.tracking_note: Watch the official series for the next edition after BIOMAG 2026.

series.name: Neuromatch Conference
series.rationale: Historically important accessible computational-neuroscience conference series; retain as watch-only until a new edition is announced.
series.tracking_note: Official Neuromatch history documents conferences through 2022; no current future edition is assumed.

series.name: NeurIPS
series.rationale: Important methods and NeuroAI-adjacent venue, but neuroscience is not its primary scope; track selectively rather than as a default publication target.

series.name: Korean Society for Computational Neuroscience Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Direct domestic computational-neuroscience community and a practical regional presentation and networking opportunity.
series.tracking_note: Watch for the next annual-meeting edition after the 2026 meeting.

series.name: KSBNS / K-Brain Annual Meeting
series.rationale: Major Korean neuroscience meeting with systems/cognitive, computational neuroscience, neuro-tools, and neuroengineering coverage.

series.name: Asia-Pacific Computational and Cognitive Neuroscience Conference (AP-CCN)
series.rationale: Regionally focused forum explicitly intended to promote computational and cognitive neuroscience and theory-experiment interaction.
series.tracking_note: Watch for a future edition after AP-CCN 2026.

series.name: China-Japan-Korea Neuroscience Meeting
series.rationale: Recurring East Asian neuroscience meeting with a confirmed 2027 edition and strong regional networking value.

series.name: International Conference on Cognitive Neuroscience (ICON)
series.rationale: Long-running cognitive-neuroscience meeting spanning neuroimaging, neurostimulation, EEG/MEG-adjacent methods, and cognition.
series.tracking_note: Latest verified official edition source is ICON 2025; watch for the next edition rather than inferring recurrence dates.
